01 · The list

Numbers,
level by level

The number words of Chinese from the HSK lists: the digits, the tens, hundred, thousand and ten thousand, with the reading and meaning of each. Numbers are the first words that pay for themselves, since prices, dates, times and phone numbers all run on them.

In Lock&Learn Chinese these words sit in their level packs (HSK 1, HSK 2, HSK 3, HSK 4 and more), one per glance on the widget: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 1 is free; every other pack opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily.

Type to filter by hanzi, pinyin or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

Mandarin has one number system, and it is regular: learn one to ten and the words for hundred, thousand and ten thousand, and every number follows. Two exceptions to know early: 两 liǎng replaces 二 èr before a measure word ("two people" is 两个人), and 零 líng marks an empty place inside a number (一百零五 is 105).

NumberHanziPinyin
1一yī
2二 / 两èr / liǎng (before a measure word)
3三sān

5五wǔ

7七qī
8八bā
9九jiǔ
10十shí
100百bǎi
1,000千qiān
10,000万wàn

Numbers stack from the top down: 二十三 èrshísān is 23, 三百 sānbǎi is 300, and Chinese groups by ten thousand, so 100,000 is 十万 shíwàn. The tone of 一 changes in speech (yí before a fourth tone, yì before the others), which dictionaries write as yī.

03 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How do I count in Chinese?

Start with one to ten from the table, then the tens, hundred and thousand; larger numbers are built by combining them, and the note above the list explains the system. The 19 words here are the number words on the HSK vocabulary lists, each with its reading.

Which HSK levels are these words from?

11 from HSK 1, 3 from HSK 2, 1 from HSK 3, 3 from HSK 4, 1 from HSK 6. The level chip on each row says where the word sits, so you can stop at your level or read ahead. Beginner-level words carry a real example sentence; the rest show word, pinyin and meaning, with their sentences in the app.

How do I learn numbers words on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. Enable the level packs these words come from (HSK 1, HSK 2, HSK 3 and more). A word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
